title: National Theatre of Greece
scope: The standing historic Ziller Building of the National Theatre of Greece at 22 Agiou Konstantinou Street, including its limestone colonnade and recessed arched main-floor facade.
limitations: The principal Ziller Building only. Separate venues and neighboring buildings are outside scope.
Published measurements of facade ornament, rear openings and roof heights were unavailable. Secondary elevations and fine ornament are approximate.
